replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Sometimes, especially when faced with complex problems. My moderate neuroticism makes me worry about making mistakes. However, I try to stay calm and break problems down into smaller, manageable parts.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I've used AI tools like Khan Academy and Photomath. They've been quite helpful, especially with step-by-step explanations. The interactive nature of these tools makes learning more engaging and less intimidating.
